newsitem.title: UK: Courtaulds steady as Hoare downgrades.
newsitem.headline: Courtaulds steady as Hoare downgrades.

text.p: Shares in Courtaulds Plc were steady in a generally strong market on Friday as analysts at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett cut earnings estimates for the chemicals group and downgraded to "hold" from "buy," traders said.
The stock was unchanged at 432-1/2 by 1227 GMT, even as the FTSE-100 index was up 21.3 points at 3,921.7.
For the year ended March 1997 Hoare Govett cut its pre-tax profit estimates by 20 percent to 155 million stg, but for fiscal 1998 it left its estimate unchanged at 200 million.
Market sources said the lower profit forecast reflected a squeeze on profit margins in textiles that was more extended than had been expected.

And sources said the rating downgrade was due to the fact that expected good news in sales of Tencel and coatings had already been reflected in the share price, which reached a 16-month high of 490p last month.
Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment.
